quests.name: The Guild's Gift
quests.offer: An apprentice alchemist wears the torn uniform; Merchant Berg upstairs has one. Merchant Berg will give it to you for nothing; show it to me when you have it.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Then go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Get the Torn Uniform from Merchant Berg.
steps.says: Here you are, at no charge.

steps.journal: Show the Torn Uniform to Jergish Anaebraum.
steps.says: Good. Now you are one of us.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data's guide (Quests/1-20/qeynos/alchemist.json, Level 1; github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data). Jergish Anaebarum is the database's Jergish Anaebraum.

quests.name: The Spiritmaster and the Coachman
quests.offer: Go to Spiritmaster Decia; you will be bound, then sent to Coachman Billfer. Come back when you have signed his ledger.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Then go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Speak with Spiritmaster Decia to be bound.
steps.says: Now go and see Coachman Billfer at the stables east of the city.

steps.journal: Sign Coachman Billfer's ledger at the stables east of the city.
steps.says: Signed. Back you go.

steps.journal: Return to Jergish Anaebraum.
steps.says: Good.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data's guide (Quests/1-20/qeynos/alchemist.json, Level 2; github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data).

quests.name: Bat Wing and Snake Fang
quests.offer: Your training continues with Kelin, right behind me. Slay bats for a ruined bat wing and snakes for a cracked snake fang, and bring them to him.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Then go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Slay bats for a ruined bat wing.
Slay snakes for a cracked snake fang.
Bring the bat wing and the snake fang to Kelin.
steps.says: Good.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data's guide (Quests/1-20/qeynos/alchemist.json, Level 3; github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data). The Hardening Agent scroll is the class's level 3 spell, the scroll the guides that name one give for this quest.

quests.name: Alchemist's Gloves
quests.offer: I'll make you a pair of gloves. Buy tailored gloves from Merchant Baine near the east gate for 75 tunar, and bring me a cracked rat claw.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Then go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Buy tailored gloves from Merchant Baine near the east gate for 75 tunar.
steps.says: Tailored gloves.

steps.journal: Slay rats outside the city for a cracked rat claw.
Bring the gloves and the rat claw to Kelin.
steps.says: Here are your gloves.

quests.name: Welsish's Orders
quests.offer: The gnolls have a new leader, Welsish Darkpaw, in a camp in the hills north of the road past the stables. Slay him and bring me his orders. He is a caster: protect yourself.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Then go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Slay Welsish Darkpaw at his camp in the hills north of the stables for his orders.
Bring Welsish's orders to Kelin.
steps.says: Good work.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data's guide (Quests/1-20/qeynos/alchemist.json, Level 5; github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data). The guide has any named gnoll of the camp carry the orders: Welsish Darkpaw carries them here. The Crude Refinement scroll is the class's level 5 spell, the scroll the guides that name one give for this quest.

quests.name: Druidic Hide
quests.offer: Jergish needs druidic hide. Speak with him.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Then go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Speak with Jergish Anaebraum.
steps.says: Kill the druidic cadavers at the cursed druid ring north of Qeynos, past the guard tower, until one gives up its hide.

steps.journal: Kill druidic cadavers at the druid ring north of Qeynos for a hide.
Bring the druidic hide to Jergish Anaebraum.
steps.says: Exactly what I needed.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data's guide (Quests/1-20/qeynos/alchemist.json, Level 7; github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data). The Crude Sublimation scroll is the class's level 7 spell, the scroll the guides that name one give for this quest.

quests.name: The Clock's Gear
quests.offer: My friend Mechanic Dwazzle, at the clock tower in front of the bank, needs help.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Then go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Speak with Mechanic Dwazzle at the clock tower.
steps.says: A thief stole one of the clock's gears: brown hair, padded armour, a staff. Try the little village east of the Silent Fist.

steps.journal: Kill Garb, in the little village east of the Silent Fist, for the small gear.
Bring the small gear to Mechanic Dwazzle.
steps.says: Now oil: fill this jar with petroleum ooze from the moat of Gildan's house in the swamp to the north.

steps.journal: Collect petroleum ooze from the moat in the swamp north of Qeynos.
Bring the ooze filled jar to Mechanic Dwazzle.
steps.says: The clock will run again. Tell Jergish.

steps.journal: Return to Jergish Anaebraum.
steps.says: Well done.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data's guide (Quests/1-20/qeynos/alchemist.json, Level 10; github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data). Mechanic Dweezle is the database's Mechanic Dwazzle. Garb and the petroleum ooze are not in the database. The jar is not used from the inventory here: the ooze's kill fills it. Reward left out (not in the database): item Small Dagger.

quests.name: The Poachers' Map
quests.offer: The order's funding will be cut unless we find the poachers stealing from the cities. They have been seen near Whale Hill, north of the ooze swamp. The pieces of their map will show us their stronghold.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Then go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Slay the shady poachers on Whale Hill for the torn piece of the map.
Slay shady poachers for the tattered piece of the map.
Slay shady poachers for the ripped piece of the map.
Slay shady poachers for the shabby piece of the map.
Bring the four pieces back to the guildhouse.

events.text: As you near the guildhouse the wind picks up and blows a piece of the map from your hands, high over the front gates!

steps.journal: Chase the piece of map to the city's front gates.

events.text: At the inner gates you see the piece of map fly to the top of the clocktower.

steps.journal: Chase the piece of map to the clocktower.

events.text: Just as you reach for it, the wind lifts it again, over the city wall.

steps.journal: Go back to the guildhouse.

events.text: Near the guildhouse you find the piece of map at your feet.

steps.journal: Bring the four pieces of the map to Jergish Anaebraum.
steps.says: I need special glue to put it together: take 207 tunar to Merchant Dwindel in Hagley.

steps.journal: Buy the super strong glue from Merchant Dwindel in Hagley for 207 tunar.
steps.says: Super strong glue.

steps.journal: Bring the super strong glue to Jergish Anaebraum.
steps.says: The map is whole again.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data's guide (Quests/1-20/qeynos/alchemist.json, Level 13; github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data). The wind's places are the guildhouse (Jergish), the inner gates (by Captain Momar's tower) and the clocktower (Mechanic Dwazzle). Merchant Dwindel is not in the database. quests.name: The Poacher Boss
quests.offer: Find the poachers' base. Take this note to Merchant Dwindel in Hagley; his potion is part of my plan.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Then go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Take the note from Jergish Anaebraum.
steps.says: Here it is.

steps.journal: Bring Jergish's note to Merchant Dwindel in Hagley.
steps.says: I need fruit from a thornless treant and the hide of a frantic badger.

steps.journal: Kill a thornless treant near Jethro's Cast for its fruit.
Kill a frantic badger on the mountainsides by Bear Cave for its hide.
Bring the fruit and the hide to Merchant Dwindel.
steps.says: Here is the potion. Drink it on Whale Hill and the poachers' boss will come.

steps.journal: On Whale Hill, as a badger, lure out the poacher boss and slay him for his emblem.
Bring the poacher's emblem to Jergish Anaebraum.
steps.says: The poachers are finished.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data's guide (Quests/1-20/qeynos/alchemist.json, Level 15; github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data). Reward left out (not in the database): item Jergish's Bracers.

quests.name: The Animal Heralds
quests.offer: After the badger business the animals are rising up. Take this note to Professor Earnum in Surefall Glade.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Then go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Take the note from Jergish Anaebraum.
steps.says: Here.

steps.journal: Bring the note to Professor Earnum in Surefall Glade.
steps.says: There is a revolt at Greyvax's caves: kill the snow leopard herald and bring me its hide.

steps.journal: Kill the snow leopard herald near Greyvax's caves for its hide.
Bring the hide to Professor Earnum.
steps.says: Now the grave rat herald near the aviak village.

steps.journal: Kill the grave rat herald near the aviak village for its pelt.
Bring the pelt to Professor Earnum.
steps.says: I need ingredients: buy them from Merchant Dwindel in Hagley for 580 tunar.

steps.journal: Buy the ingredients from Merchant Dwindel for 580 tunar.
steps.says: Here you are.

steps.journal: Bring the ingredients to Professor Earnum.
steps.says: Last, the young bear herald near Blackburrow.

steps.journal: Kill the young bear herald near Blackburrow for its pelt.
Bring the pelt to Professor Earnum.
steps.says: The uprising is over. Go back to Jergish.

steps.journal: Return to Jergish Anaebraum.
steps.says: You have saved the order.
